text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That description of appearing "drunk" while walking aligns perfectly with the ataxia seen in Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given the MRI findings, we must determine if this is due to an uncontrolled opportunistic infection or if you have recently undergone chemotherapy or are taking immunosuppressants for another condition.
